title: Mathematical Activities in North Africa 3/5
lineage: Inspected only the stated passages; original bytes retained.

passages.note: Describes a lost commentary on Abū Kāmil, quotes its use by Ibn Zakariyā and names al-Qurashī’s death in 1184.
Attributes the prime-factor method to al-Qurashī and comments on later expositors and legal practitioners.
